releaseNotes:
- New non-rigid stitching refinement: local distortion is corrected tile by tile, which removes most of the visible seam lines in mosaics.
- Fracture tab: improved crack ridge detection and display. Results are more readable and can be customised.
- New line profile: on any result tab, press the markers button, then drag across the image to plot the field along a segment. Clicking still places a marker.
- Interface reworked throughout: unified colours, a Help menu and an About box, clearer parameter labels and grouping.
- PNG and tiled TIFF images can now be read, and a demo dataset ships with the installer.
- Better stability and computation performance, and various minor bugs addressed.
